_help._file: When the AI players talk (banter). The game names its moments from its own events (its plug's moments(event, seat)); each personality's lines live in content/text/en.json "banter": { "<personality>": { "<moment>": "…", "<moment>_2": "…" } } and show in the emote bubble by its seat (mute a bot = it says nothing). The Dev Kit's AI tab edits the lines.
_help.chance: Per moment: how likely a fully chatty (100) personality is to say something, 0–1. It's multiplied by the personality's chattiness ÷ 100. A moment that isn't listed here is never spoken at. The keys ARE the game's moments.
_help.cooldownTurns: Moves at the table a bot stays quiet after it speaks.
_help.alwaysAllowed: Moments that ignore the cooldown (the end of the game).
_help.presets: Preset emotes (content/emotes.json phrases) a bot presses at a moment it has no lines of its own for.
_help.delay: Seconds between the moment and the line (picked between min and max). On the game's rules clock: a pause stops it.
_help.tableGap: Seconds after any bot speaks before another may: a second bot answers a beat later (or lets it go if that would come too late after its moment), so two bubbles never talk over each other. Keep it longer than a bubble shows (content/emotes.json bubble.showMs, 2.5 s) and bots never have two bubbles up at once (two at once side by side can stack awkwardly). 0 = off.
_help.levels: The player's "Bot chatter" setting (Settings → Off · Some · Lots). Off = the bots say nothing at all. Some and Lots: chanceTimes multiplies every moment's chance above (never past 1); cooldownTurns, when given, shortens the one above (never makes it longer). Some = ×1 = this file's own numbers.
_help.answerPeople: Moments a PERSON's move always gets an answer to (like Sparky in MTG Arena): when a person causes one of these, the chattiest bot with a line for it always says one — no chance roll, no cooldown (still not when it's muted, the game is paused, or chatter is Off). Only one bot answers. The game's moment map must say who caused it: { "moment": "rivalBigMove", "by": seat }.
